theme.zh-CN: 可获得的本体与可复现研究

observed.zh-CN: 开放本体、研究型机械臂和商业人形已有不同形式的设计或产品入口。
observed.en: Open bodies, research arms and commercial humanoids expose different design or product entry points.

gap.zh-CN: 可获得硬件仍不等于通用任务能力；个体差异、散热和维护会影响复现。
gap.en: Access to hardware does not establish general task capability; unit variation, heat and service affect reproduction.

next.zh-CN: 在明确配置与任务上报告成功、故障、维修和重复试验。
next.en: Report success, failures, repairs and repeated trials for explicit configurations and tasks.

observed.zh-CN: 扩散策略与视觉语言动作模型提供了可研究的动作生成路线。
observed.en: Diffusion policies and vision-language-action models provide concrete action-generation research routes.

gap.zh-CN: 跨场景、长时程和真实异常恢复不能由单一演示证明。
gap.en: A single demonstration cannot establish cross-scene, long-horizon or real failure-recovery ability.

next.zh-CN: 对齐训练数据、机器人配置、未见条件及人工介入预算。
next.en: Align training data, robot configurations, unseen conditions and intervention budgets.

theme.zh-CN: 世界预测与可执行规划

observed.zh-CN: 世界模型、语言技能规划和空间价值表示分别提供闭环中的不同能力。
observed.en: World models, language-based skill planning and spatial value representations contribute different closed-loop capabilities.

gap.zh-CN: 预测看起来合理，不代表动作满足物理约束或能可靠恢复。
gap.en: Plausible predictions do not establish physically constrained actions or reliable recovery.

next.zh-CN: 比较有无该模块时的任务收益、错误预测与失败恢复。
next.en: Compare task benefit, incorrect predictions and recovery with and without the module.

theme.zh-CN: 数据工具链与跨本体复用

observed.zh-CN: 多机构数据集、便携示教与开源工具链形成互补的数据入口。
observed.en: Multi-institution data, portable teaching and open toolchains provide complementary data entry points.

gap.zh-CN: 数据量无法替代动作语义、时间同步、授权和分布覆盖。
gap.en: Volume cannot substitute for action semantics, synchronization, permission and distribution coverage.

next.zh-CN: 记录数据版本、来源、隔离划分和新增真实任务收益。
next.en: Record versions, provenance, isolated splits and gains on new real tasks.

observed.zh-CN: 物理引擎、训练框架与双臂任务生成工具支持更可控的实验。
observed.en: Physics engines, training frameworks and bimanual task generation support more controlled experiments.

gap.zh-CN: 接触、传感与资产误差仍需真实验证；合成指标不能替代实机指标。
gap.en: Contact, sensor and asset errors still require physical validation; synthetic metrics do not replace real metrics.

next.zh-CN: 固定仿真版本、随机化范围、真实校准与迁移测试条件。
next.en: Pin simulator versions, randomization ranges, real calibration and transfer-test conditions.

observed.zh-CN: 研究灵巧手、商品化末端和触觉器件提供不同接触能力。
observed.en: Research hands, commercial end effectors and tactile devices provide different contact capabilities.

gap.zh-CN: 更多自由度或触点不自动带来更好的控制；还受耐久、标定和数据约束。
gap.en: More joints or taxels do not automatically improve control; durability, calibration and data remain constraints.

next.zh-CN: 比较感知增益、任务效果、控制延迟和更换维护成本。
next.en: Compare sensing benefit, task outcomes, control latency and replacement or service cost.

observed.zh-CN: 控制、导航、操作、机队和数据工具分别覆盖系统集成环节。
observed.en: Control, navigation, manipulation, fleet and data tools cover different integration layers.

gap.zh-CN: 接口存在不等于系统互通；版本、时序、故障语义仍须逐项验证。
gap.en: Interfaces do not establish interoperability; versions, timing and failure semantics need explicit verification.

next.zh-CN: 保留部署配置、端到端测试、故障注入和回滚记录。
next.en: Retain deployment configurations, end-to-end tests, fault injection and rollback records.

observed.zh-CN: 运营方披露的物流案例说明了具体任务与商业交付之间的连接。
observed.en: An operator-disclosed logistics case connects a specific task with commercial delivery.

gap.zh-CN: 单个场地案例不能代表全行业成熟；维护、改造和停机成本须纳入。
gap.en: One site does not represent industry-wide maturity; service, retrofit and downtime costs must be included.

next.zh-CN: 同时记录任务周期、可用时长、介入、故障恢复和完整成本。
next.en: Record cycle time, availability duration, interventions, recovery and full cost together.
